Hey there @home-assistant/cloud, mind taking a look at this pull request as its been labeled with a integration (`google_assistant`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L154) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

I have this PR pulled in 0.111.0.dev0 and it's working well with my tests. A helper was created and then synced with Google Assistant. Word options for input selects work very well, but GA has difficulty when using numbers as options whether using numerals or spelling them out, giving mixed results when "1" does not match "one" or vice versa...nothing to be done about that, though. :+1: 

All of these variations worked:
"Change the monkey badger to helpful"
"Set monkey badger to calm"
"Make monkey badger rabid"
